summary: Bound-checked __thiscall accessor over a pointer array embedded in the object. For an index a2 below 44 it reads the entry at this[2*a2 + 2220] and returns it; a null entry falls back to the global byte_5EA438, and an out-of-range index returns 0. Called from MessageNameBufferUpdate, SessionEntryListCleanup and KeyBindingUIPressKeyOrController.

local_names.this: object holding a pointer array whose entries sit 2 dwords apart starting at dword index 2220
local_names.result: returned pointer; zero when the selector is out of range

operations.description: Initialize the default result to 0 before any guard.
Only when a2 is less than 44 is the object array consulted; otherwise the function falls through returning 0.
Read the entry pointer at this[2 * a2 + 2220]; the 2-dword index step means array entries are 8 bytes apart with the pointer in the first dword.
If the entry pointer is null, return the global byte_5EA438 as the fallback value.
Return the non-null entry pointer, the byte_5EA438 fallback, or 0 for an out-of-range a2.
Shared by MessageNameBufferUpdate (0x0046AD50), SessionEntryListCleanup (0x0046AE60) and KeyBindingUIPressKeyOrController (0x0046B0C0) to fetch a per-slot string or name pointer.
